operation.description: Use this API to reject a buyer's return or refund request.

parameters.name: return_id
parameters.description: The identifier of a specific return request.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description: The idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize the same request. How you create unique keys is up to you, but we suggest using UUIDs, or another random string with enough entropy to avoid collisions. Idempotency keys can be up to 255 characters long.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

comment.description: Seller's comment on the rejection decision. This is where a seller will provide more information about rejecting the request.
comment.example: I have reached an agreement with the buyer

decision.description:
Return decision, available values:
- `REJECT_REFUND`: Seller rejects the refund request
- `REJECT_RETURN`: Seller rejects the return request
- `REJECT_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`: Seller rejects the received package
- `REJECT_REPLACEMENT`: Seller rejects the replacement request

images.description: List of images provided by the seller to support their decision to reject the return request.

image_id.description: Image URI obtained from the [Upload Product Image](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509df95defece02be598a22) API.

reject_reason.description: Seller's reason to reject buyer's return request. Please use the [Get Reject Reasons](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650ab658defece02be706f98) endpoint to obtain a list of rejection reasons.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
